ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within rectangle $ABCD$, diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$, $AC=10$, and $\angle ACB = 30^\circ$. What is the length of $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rectangle,\\
it follows that $\angle ABC=90^\circ$.\\
Since AC=10 and $\angle ACB=30^\circ$,\\
it follows that AB=5.\\
Since quadrilateral ABCD is a rectangle,\\
it follows that CD=AB=5.\\
Therefore, the length of CD is $\boxed{5}$.
